newsitem.title: CANADA: Unitel changes name to AT&T Canada.
newsitem.headline: Unitel changes name to AT&T Canada.

text.p: AT & T Corp -controlled Unitel Communications Ltd said it will officially change its name to AT&T Canada, effective September 9.
In a letter to customers dated September 3, Unitel said the name change will mean customers will be entitled to the benefits offered under the global AT&T program.
In January AT&T completed a deal in which it and three Canadian banks agreed to take a 67-percent interest and inject C$250 million in money-losing Unitel.

In April BCE Inc unit Bell Canada filed an application with the Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission (CRTC) which called for a "full and open disclosure" of the AT&T/Unitel deal. Bell wanted an end to subsidies and other regulatory advantages that are extended to foreign-backed competitors operating in Canada.
In its letter Unitel assured its customers that "Our Customer Service Centres were built by Canadians for Canadians -- and will remain that way."
Unitel said earlier today it will hold a news conference on September 9 to make a "major announcement."
